title: The Man Who Mapped the Himalayas in Disguise
notes: Register: adventure, with genuine admiration. Part 4 is honest about whose interests the maps served; that honesty never shrinks his achievement.

Motion: this is the most explainer-heavy video. The rosary counter, the pace gauge, the boiling-point diagram and the route lines drawing across maps carry it; a pace counter runs whenever Nain Singh walks.
Nain Singh is a cartoon with a vague face. His real face appears only in the small portrait (p04) and the 2004 stamp (p13). Commons also has 'Nain Singh Thapa.jpg': a DIFFERENT PERSON. Never use it.

Lhasa and the real Tibetan places are never generated as they were in the 1860s. Lhasa is the Bichurin image (p01) and a dot on the maps; the Tsangpo is the real photographs. Generated places are generic mountains, plateaus and rooms.
The centrepiece is Henry Trotter's 1877 RGS map (p05). The original is a 78MB TIFF; file_url is Wikimedia's 3840px JPEG rendering of it, and page_url is the TIFF's page for attribution.
The stamp (p13) is GODL-India and requires attribution to India Post, Government of India.
Generated rosaries, prayer wheels and paper rolls carry no script or figures; every number is set by the animation layer.
Pronunciation notes for Chirp are at the top of narration.md.
LOW RESOLUTION: p04 (283px) and p13 (235px). Native size only.
Every archival URL was resolved from the Commons API.
Guide object: the 100-bead rosary (s03, s22-s23, s54).

nain.desc: Nain Singh, a Kumaoni schoolteacher of the 1860s: disguised in the thick red-brown robes and fur hat of a Tibetan trader, carrying a prayer wheel and a rosary; also as a boy, and as a teacher in a plain jacket and turban; simple vague face

mani.desc: Mani Singh, Nain Singh's cousin, also disguised as a Tibetan trader in robes and a fur hat, simple vague face

montgomerie.desc: Captain Thomas Montgomerie of the Survey of India, 1860s, in a dark frock coat with side whiskers, simple vague face

crowd.desc: extras: 19th-century survey teams hauling instruments, a British officer at a border post, a trading caravan with yaks, Lhasa merchants at a ledger, young recruits, simple vague faces

sets.tibet_trail: a high mountain trail across a vast cold plateau, snowy peaks on the horizon, a huge pale sky, no buildings

sets.milam: a small stone village high in the Himalaya below a great glacier, terraced fields, prayer flags, cold bright light
sets.schoolroom: a stone-walled village schoolroom in the mountains, a teacher's desk, a slate, light through a small window
sets.training_yard: a dusty parade ground at a hill station, a long straight path marked with posts, deodar trees
sets.map_tibet: a large vintage parchment map of the Himalaya and southern Tibet, a great river running east-west, a lake, unmarked
sets.merchant_room: a dim merchant's room with rough plastered walls, a low wooden table, rugs, a butter lamp
sets.rooftop_night: a flat earthen rooftop at night under a sky dense with stars, dark mountains beyond
sets.plateau: a vast cold high plateau under a huge pale sky, a flat white salt lake in the middle distance, low bare mountains far beyond
sets.map_asia: a large vintage parchment map of Central Asia from the Russian steppes to British India, mountains hatched, unmarked
sets.dusk_courtyard: an empty courtyard at dusk with a single small oil lamp burning on a low wall, quiet and still
sets.archive_shelf: a long shelf of old bound scientific journals in an archive, leather spines, dim light
sets.snow_path: a high mountain path across fresh snow, vast pale peaks beyond

props.prayer_wheel: a Tibetan hand prayer wheel of copper and wood, spinning
props.rosary: a hand-strung rosary of plain dark wooden beads, every tenth bead noticeably larger than the others
props.paper_roll: a narrow roll of paper with faint pencil marks too small to read
props.theodolite: a huge 19th-century brass survey theodolite on a heavy tripod
props.trade_goods: sacks of grain and bolts of cloth on one side, bundles of wool and sacks of salt on the other
props.slate: a small slate and a wooden pointer
props.instruments: a brass pocket compass, a small sextant and a slim glass thermometer laid out for inspection
props.mercury_bowl: a plain wooden bowl with a hidden pool of mercury in its base
props.boiling_pot: a small battered metal pot of water boiling over a low fire, a slim glass thermometer beside it, steam rising
props.ledger: a merchant's ledger lying open, the entries only soft illegible marks
props.gold_watch: a gold pocket watch lying open on dark cloth, its chain coiled beside it, no inscription
props.medal: a gold medal on a ribbon in an open case
props.rosaries_row: a row of identical wooden rosaries hanging from pegs, each with every tenth bead larger
props.footprints: a line of evenly spaced footprints across fresh snow, each step exactly the same length
